title: Acceptance: Ctrl-C under flood at 300 ms RTT, LAN throughput, convergence; D3 evidence
description:
Spec §5 and §6. tests/mosh_pacing.rs (non-ignored tests): (1) Ctrl-C under flood: set_link(150, R) with R and terminal size from evidence/phase2-baseline.md; pane runs `yes; echo <marker>`; wait for 2 s of flood growth; write \x03 to the client pty; assert the marker appears on the client screen within 1.5 s. (2) No throughput regression: no link knob, same flood; keeper trace shows the window reaching >= 1 MiB. (3) Convergence: under the slow profile the traced window settles to <= max(FLOOR, 2*R*0.3 s) + one chunk. Then write evidence/phase2-acceptance.md: Ctrl-C latency over >= 3 runs before (from the baseline file) and after, and server_backlog from the keeper trace with staleness = backlog/R; if its p95 exceeds 250 ms, the file states that D3's evidence for server pacing is met and parks server pacing (and the SO_SNDBUF option) as a measured follow-up — not built here.

title: Wire InflightWindow into SessionEndpoint; size source reads; keeper window trace
description:
Spec §2, §3, §7 and the ## Key abstractions SessionEndpoint/Keeper/LocalBridge entries. SessionEndpoint owns one InflightWindow and is the only place that feeds it: poll_send reports fresh (non-replay) DATA sends; the ACK path reports the new acked offset; set_up and leg_down reset it; may_read_source, poll_send's room and a new source_room() use the controller's window while up and the ring cap while down; WINDOW becomes the hard cap and push_source's debug assertion is restated against it. The endpoint marks the epoch window-limited when it had bytes to send and no room OR when the source was refused room (occupancy reached the window) — the gap noted in the spec's Key abstractions. It passes the epoch snapshot to its owner unchanged. Keeper server_reader reads min(MAX_DATA_CHUNK, source_room()) rounded up to 4 KiB; on each epoch snapshot the keeper reads FIONREAD on that session's server stream and emits one `window` trace event {window, base_rtt, epoch_min, server_backlog} under HERDR_MOSH_TRACE. The local bridge's client reader sizes reads with source_room(); no trace there. Rewrite the session unit tests that assert in-flight == WINDOW to assert the controller's window.
owns: SessionEndpoint::source_room() and the keeper `window` trace event schema {leg, window, base_rtt, epoch_min, server_backlog}, emitted through the existing keeper trace file (HERDR_MOSH_TRACE, the same channel as the Phase 1 keeper events) and read by tests via Remote::keeper_events, where `leg` identifies the leg (the keeper's leg generation) and a `window` event with the reset value is emitted when a new leg comes up.
consumes: InflightWindow; the backlog metric definition from mosh-hex.3 (server_backlog = FIONREAD on the keeper's server stream, the same quantity as ss Recv-Q).
RTT comes only from existing DATA/ACK traffic: no session message, field or constant is added or changed.
blocked-by mosh-hex.2: consumes InflightWindow
blocked-by mosh-hex.3: consumes fixed-window baseline recorded in evidence/phase2-baseline.md (the baseline must be measured before the window changes)
Files: src/mosh/session.rs, src/mosh/remote/keeper.rs, src/mosh/local_bridge.rs.
Acceptance:
- [ ] Unit tests: in-flight and ring occupancy never exceed the controller's window while up (the keeper stops reading the server when source_room() is 0, so backpressure stays in the server socket and the server's latest-wins slot); ring cap rule unchanged while down; replay after reconnect respects the (reset) window; source_room() is 0 when occupancy >= window.
- [ ] Keeper unit/integration test: a `window` trace event appears under flood with all four fields.
- [ ] Session protocol unchanged: SESSION_PROTOCOL_VERSION, ACK_EVERY_BYTES, ACK_EVERY, MAX_DATA_CHUNK and WINDOW values unchanged; a receiver built from the base code still interoperates (existing tests/mosh_* suites green).

description:

title: InflightWindow controller in src/mosh/window.rs
description:
Spec §1 and ## Key abstractions (InflightWindow entry, carried verbatim in the root epic digest). Pure sans-IO struct, mounted in src/mosh/mod.rs. Records first-transmission instants of fresh DATA chunk end offsets (bounded deque, <= WINDOW/MAX_DATA_CHUNK entries); samples RTT only on ACKs advancing >= ACK_EVERY_BYTES, never on replayed bytes (Karn); base_rtt = min on the current leg; per-epoch epoch_min; epoch ends at the first ACK covering the first byte sent after the epoch began; once per epoch: q = epoch_min - base_rtt; q > 50 ms -> window = max(FLOOR, window*3/4); else if window-limited this epoch -> window = min(CAP, window + MAX_DATA_CHUNK); else hold. Constants FLOOR = 2*ACK_EVERY_BYTES (128 KiB), INITIAL = 256 KiB, CAP = WINDOW (2 MiB), TARGET_QUEUE_DELAY = 50 ms. Reset -> INITIAL, no samples. Window-limited is an input reported by its owner. Epoch close yields a snapshot (window, base_rtt, epoch_min) the owner can take.
owns: InflightWindow (type, constants, control law, responsibility comment).
Files: src/mosh/window.rs (new), src/mosh/mod.rs (one mod line, fork file).
Acceptance:
- [ ] The type carries its responsibility comment: what it owns, what it doesn't, where new control behaviour goes, its role (sans-IO delay-based controller).
- [ ] Unit tests with a synthetic clock: queueing delay above 50 ms shrinks by 3/4 per epoch down to FLOOR; window-limited epochs with no queueing grow by one chunk up to CAP; an idle (not window-limited) link never grows; reset returns to INITIAL with no samples.
- [ ] Unit tests: ACKs advancing < ACK_EVERY_BYTES produce no sample; replayed bytes (after reset) are never sampled; implausible inputs (ACK below oldest record, empty deque) are ignored without panic.
- [ ] No IO, no clock reads, no tracing inside window.rs.

title: Link-emulation harness: delay-and-rate link knob for the fake ssh
description:
Spec §4. Add a `link` knob to tests/mosh_harness.rs holding `<one-way delay ms> <rate bytes/s>`; when present the fake ssh pipes both directions of a session or plain leg through a Perl delay line the harness writes beside the fake ssh (each chunk read at t released at max(t+delay, prev_release + len/rate); single-threaded select loop, in-memory queue; same pattern as the existing `throttle` knob). Add Remote::set_link(delay, rate) and Remote::clear_link(). No loss emulation.
owns: link knob + Remote::set_link/clear_link (harness API consumed by the measurement and acceptance tests).
Files: tests/mosh_harness.rs (and a small self-test in tests/mosh_pacing.rs or an existing tests/mosh_*.rs file).
Acceptance:
- [ ] With set_link(150, R) a session attaches and works (existing resume-style smoke passes through the delay line).
- [ ] A self-test measures a round trip through the delay line of >= 300 ms and a sustained rate within 20% of R (e.g. 1 MiB/s).
- [ ] clear_link restores the undelayed path; no knob present = byte-identical behaviour to today.
- [ ] No root, tc or new Cargo dependency; perl only, as the throttle knob already requires.

title: Mosh Phase 2: adaptive keeper in-flight window
description:
Phase 2 of HERDR_MOSH_VISION.md: an adaptive, delay-based sender window keeps about one link of output in flight, so Ctrl-C under an output flood answers within 1.5 s at 300 ms RTT. Spec: docs/superpowers/runs/2026-10-28-mosh-phase2-keeper-inflight-window/2026-10-28-mosh-phase2-keeper-inflight-window-design.md

## Global Constraints
- All new code under src/mosh/ (mounted already) and tests/mosh_*.rs. Every edit to an upstream file is a one-statement hook tagged `// mosh-fork hook`; upstream diff budget <= 20 lines (scripts/mosh-diff-budget.sh, currently 12; this phase plans 0 new hook lines).
- No change to the herdr wire, PROTOCOL_VERSION or hello fields; no change to the session protocol (SESSION_PROTOCOL_VERSION stays 1; receiver ack policy ACK_EVERY_BYTES/ACK_EVERY untouched).
- No new Cargo dependencies (libc is already present).
- Tests only in fork files (src/mosh #[cfg(test)] modules and tests/mosh_*.rs).
- Conventional-commit messages without AI co-author lines (repo AGENTS.md). Rust: no unwrap() in production code; tracing for logging.
- Build needs zig 0.16.0 (~/.local/bin/zig). Sweep: cargo nextest run --locked --no-fail-fast && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check.
<!-- key-abstractions digest: begin -->
- InflightWindow: owns the in-flight window value, RTT sampling (Karn, ack-quantum gating), epochs and the delay-based grow/shrink law;
  new control behaviour and constants are added in `src/mosh/window.rs` only;
  callers never compare RTTs, apply window arithmetic or emit traces from it; they feed send/ACK/reset events through `SessionEndpoint` and read the current window or epoch snapshot.
